preconditions.description: The number of volumes n must be between 1 and 100000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each number in the output must be a valid volume number between 1 and n.
All numbers in the output must be distinct, ensuring each volume is placed exactly once.
